title: Training Language and Literacy for Children Who Use CIs
brief_summary: This study aims to determine the effectiveness of computer games to improve language and literacy outcomes for children who have hearing loss. Children will be assigned to one of four conditions: phonological awareness training, working memory training, phonological awareness + working memory training, or active control.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Prelingual hearing loss
* Use of amplification device (hearing aid and/or cochlear implant) for at least one year
* Able to visit the clinic 3x/week for 12 weeks

Exclusion Criteria:

* No developmental delays (Down's syndrome, Autism spectrum disorder)
